lines: The trip made the village feel larger and home feel more exact.
I learned which roads look safe from here and which ones only pretend.
Next time, I pack lighter, listen faster, and trust the quiet <pulse>less</pulse>.
Going out there reminded me why doors matter.
I brought back more than sore feet. I brought back a sharper idea of <pulse>home</pulse>.
A village looks different after you have had to find your way back to it.
